test_title: PYST 56: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held on: 13th November 2021 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will complete the series.

Z _ T _ V _ X T D _ Z _ _ D V

options.text: X D Z V X T
X D Z V D T
Z D Z V X T
X D X V X T

solution:
Given sequence: Z _ T _ V _ X T D _ Z _ _ D V

 
• X D Z V X T → Z **X** T **D** V - **Z** X T D **V -** Z **X T** D V
 
• X D Z V D T → Z X T D V - Z X T D V - Z **D** T D V
 
• Z D Z V X T → Z **Z** T D V - Z X T D V - Z X T D V
 
• X D X V X T → Z X T D V - **X** X T D V - Z X T D V

 
• In option 1, ZXTDV is repeated.

Hence, '**X D Z V X T**' is the correct answer.
